premises.text: Consumers and caregivers lack easy control over meaningful personal health measurements
premises.evidence_span: empowering you to take control of your health

premises.text: Dyno is a thermometer-simple multi-sensor device delivering dozens of metrics including cuffless BP to phone or cradle in one minute
premises.evidence_span: It works just as simple as a digital thermometer, and it takes only 60 seconds to get it done

premises.text: Analytic software can surface unknown conditions in elderly-care settings, enabling specialist referral and preventive intervention
premises.evidence_span: these individuals and their care organization had no idea of these conditions

premises.text: Go-to-market spans elderly care, chronic disease, hospital discharge under ACA incentives, and consumers, monetized by subscription, OEM/licensing, and data mining

value.text: Preventive care that improves quality of care and avoids costly acute events
value.evidence_span: A true step forward in preventive care
